t: A fast, low-cost RISC-V chip with two USB ports.
steps: Buy an Adafruit QT Py CH32V203 from Adafruit.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the WCH Arduino core with the board manager and pick the QT Py CH32V203.
Hold the boot button as you plug in the board to enter its USB bootloader.
Open a simple LED example and press Upload. The color LED lights up.
Follow the Adafruit learning guide for the next steps.
meta: Wild Open. From $4.95. A few stores.
